Create a square futuristic biotechnology editorial poster combining a highly realistic 3D CGI synthetic-human portrait, a strict Swiss-style graphic grid, and scientific botanical archive infographics.
Place a synthetic female bust at the center, occupying roughly 65% of the canvas and rising from the bottom edge. Her head tilts gently backward and toward the left, eyes naturally closed, lips slightly parted, with a calm, sacred and emotionally distant expression. Show her face in a three-quarter view with an elongated neck and a complete right shoulder. Her surface combines pearl-white ceramic, translucent resin, cool gray liquid metal and localized mirrored chrome. Add delicate metallic veins, transparent biological tissue and elegant structural seams while preserving correct facial anatomy, proportions and neck-to-shoulder construction.
A dense crown of futuristic botanical growth emerges naturally from her scalp, behind the ears, along the neck and over the shoulders, expanding toward the upper-right corner. Include translucent glass petals, crystalline leaves, liquid-metal flowers, soft pearl-white blossoms, blue-violet transparent foliage, magenta stamens, small berries, thin vines and fine golden conductive branches. Every plant must have a believable physical attachment to the body; nothing should float or penetrate the anatomy randomly. Transparent materials must show realistic thickness, refraction and rim highlights. Metallic surfaces should reflect the pale violet, icy cyan and magenta environment.
Use a clean, high-key pale gray-white and light lavender background with subtle paper grain, micro-dot patterns, coordinate grids, scanning lines, botanical diagrams, orbital circles, technical linework and translucent cyan geometric panels. Avoid a black background, excessive neon glow and decorative particle clutter.
Follow a precise editorial layout. Place the huge bright-red condensed bold sans-serif title “DESIGN” across the upper-left two-thirds of the poster. Allow the central figure and botanical crown to partially overlap the letters, but keep the title straight, sharp and readable.
Below the title on the left, display exactly:\
“SYNTHETIC BOTANY”\
“COLLECTION”\
“/001”
Create a translucent lavender information module in the lower-left containing a fine botanical seal and exactly:\
“BOTANICAL CLASSIFICATION”\
“FLR-001-A”\
“CYBER FLORA SPECIES”\
“FLORA DIVINA”
Reserve approximately 15% of the canvas width for a separate vertical white information column on the right, divided from the main image by a thin black line. At the top, include a white botanical line drawing, orbital diagram and precise geometric markers. In the middle, set the following information vertically in small magenta sans-serif type:\
“FLR 001”\
“23°42'N”\
“118°04'E”\
“ELEV. 23.4m”\
“CLASS: MAGNOLIACEAE”\
“ORDER: MAGNOLIALES”\
“FAMILY: FLORADIVINAE”\
“GENUS: FLORA”\
“SPECIES: DIVINA”\
“STATUS: SYNTHETIC / STABLE”
In the lower part of the right column, display:\
“SYNTHETIC BOTANY”\
“/ SPECIMEN 001”
Below it, display this compact paragraph:\
“IN THE YEAR 2084, HUMANITY ACHIEVED THE HARMONIOUS FUSION OF BIOLOGY AND TECHNOLOGY. FLORA DIVINA IS THE FIRST SYNTHETIC BOTANICAL SPECIES CREATED THROUGH QUANTUM BIOENGINEERING. SHE BLOSSOMS ETERNALLY BETWEEN CODE AND LIFE.”
Overlay a horizontal translucent lavender-gray frosted information band across the bottom, edged with thin icy-cyan lines. It may cover the lower chest but must not cover the face. Inside the band, arrange four precise white botanical line drawings from left to right and display exactly:\
“SEED — STAGE /01”\
“BLOOM — STAGE /02”\
“SYNTHESIS — STAGE /03”\
“INTEGRATION — STAGE /04”
Use pearl white, pale gray-violet and icy blue as the dominant colors, with cobalt, violet and cyan reflections in the transparent plants, vivid red and magenta typography, and restrained champagne-gold branches. Use soft, cool, high-key frontal illumination with a blue-violet rim light on the right-side botanical crown. Preserve realistic refraction through the petals, controlled specular highlights and soft dimensional shadows across the face.
The finished image should feel like a premium fashion editorial, a futuristic scientific archive and a bio-art exhibition identity: precise, clean, controlled and information-rich, with a clear grid and no cheap AI aesthetic. All specified text must be spelled correctly, horizontal and consistently typeset. Do not generate any additional text, gibberish, pseudo-letters, extra logos or watermarks.

# Ideogram 4 结构化海报文生图｜非商业测试版

## 只需三步
1. 在绿色节点 **01 JSON 提示词** 中粘贴完整的 Ideogram 4  提示词。
2. 在绿色节点 **02 选择画幅** 中选择比例；默认 1:1、约 1MP。
3. 点击运行，在右侧 **04 生成结果** 查看并下载图片。

## 重要限制
- Ideogram 4 本地模型优先读取结构化 JSON，不建议直接粘贴普通自然语言。
- 工作流没有独立负向提示词；不需要的内容应写进 JSON 的背景或元素描述。
- 默认使用 **Default 20 步**，适合日常生成。文字密集的最终稿可展开紫色核心节点，将 mode 改为 **Quality 48 步**。
- 模型、编码器、VAE 和引导参数已经固定，普通用户不要修改。
